what: Boards stacked in one spot (circle illustrations etc.) fade to the next board every 4.5s over a 1s ease, and the ring around the number circle draws a full turn in a straight line (linear) during those 4.5s, then redraws from the start the moment the board changes. is-active is reattached to the current board, so CSS motion such as inner text rising replays for each board

options.every: Interval the panel stays (s), default 4.5 — length of one ring loop
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Ring SVG circle·path (optional) — length is measured and drawn

note: The original uses slick (fade, autoplaySpeed 4500, speed 1000) with a separate progress circle — this part gives the same tempo without slick. The ring SVG should be rotated -90° by the caller so it starts at 12 o’clock

from.where: index.html .mk-slide four illustrations inside the circle + .mk-progress (original idx.js — slick fade autoplaySpeed 4500 · speed 1000, on every beforeChange the .path stroke-dashoffset goes length → 0 over 4500ms linear, starting 50ms later)
